L21-46 require maintenance/cowork spawns to go through the task:on-demand:<agent>:<date> mutex-wrap and be triggered on-demand/deliberately. BOUNDED-1 idle-capacity automation is the OPPOSITE of on-demand — it is unattended, cap=1, no deliberate trigger. Auto-firing agent-father (which edits agent .md / flow docs / SKILLs = the agent factory) on an idle tick violates the 'on-demand only' invariant and skips the maintenance mutex-wrap.
why_still_withheld.reason_2_execution_path_cannot_route_to_: Even setting the maintenance-lane rule aside, the BOUNDED-1 -> execute-tier -> zone-detect dispatch path CANNOT reach agent-father. main.md L512/L519 both state the claimed row 'resolves the real specialist via zone-detect skill' from the task zone/files — the execution path re-derives the agent from ZONE, it does NOT honor the board row's next_agent. .claude/skills/zone-detect/SKILL.md only ever yields dev-<service> (Tier 1/2, needs apps/<service>/-shaped zone) or 'developer' (Tier 3 fallback) — it has NO path to agent-father or any maintenance/non-dev agent. UC-ASL-P6 zone='cross-service/' (non-apps) => zone-detect Tier-3 => 'developer'. So a launch would mis-route agent-father's factory work (purge phantom DASHBOARD.md refs from system-auditor flow docs + align signal-dashboard SKILL.md) to a generic developer — the EXACT harm the original 10:07Z withhold prevented, re-introduced by a different mechanism (board-next_agent set but execution-path-ignored).
